import json,sys,coverage,re
from pathlib import Path
from carnot.reporting.current_work_receipt import sha256_file
raw=Path(sys.argv[1]); private=Path(sys.argv[2]); root=Path(sys.argv[3])
report=raw/'logs/changed_code_coverage.json'
receipt=next(r for r in json.loads((raw/'validation_receipts.json').read_bytes())['rows'] if r['name']=='coverage_json')
assert sha256_file(report)==receipt['coverage_reference']['sha256']
report_value=json.loads(report.read_bytes())
work=json.loads((raw/'measurement.json').read_bytes())
refs={r['path']:r['sha256'] for r in work['code_config_hashes']}
from carnot.verify import delayed_utility_execution_8225 as legacy
mapping={}
for name in legacy.OWNED:
    assert sha256_file(root/name)==refs[str(root/name)]
    mapping[str(root/name)]=report_value['files'][name]['executed_lines']
prior=raw.parent/'1791379474837412104-final-batch'
prior_receipt=json.loads((prior/'logs/final_coverage_report.receipt.json').read_bytes())
console=prior/'logs/final_coverage_report.stdout'
assert sha256_file(console)==prior_receipt['stdout_sha256']
current_refs={r['path']:r['sha256'] for r in json.loads((prior/'measurement.json').read_bytes())['code_config_hashes']}
from carnot.verify import learning_validation_8235 as current
analysis=coverage.Coverage(config_file=str(private/'coverage.ini'),data_file='/tmp/carnot-8235-source-analysis.coverage')
for name in current.OWNED:
    assert sha256_file(root/name)==current_refs[str(root/name)]
    row=re.search(r'^'+re.escape(name)+r'\s+(\d+)\s+(\d+)\s+\d+%\s*([^
]*)',console.read_text(),re.MULTILINE)
    assert row is not None
    statements=set(analysis.analysis2(str(root/name))[1])
    assert len(statements)==int(row.group(1))
    missing=set()
    for item in row.group(3).split(','):
        item=item.strip()
        if not item: continue
        bounds=item.split('-')
        missing.update(range(int(bounds[0]),int(bounds[-1])+1))
    assert len(missing)==int(row.group(2)) and missing <= statements
    mapping[str(root/name)]=sorted(set(mapping.get(str(root/name),[])) | (statements-missing))
data=coverage.CoverageData(basename=str(private/'.coverage.current_baseline'))
data.add_lines(mapping); data.write()
print(json.dumps({'authenticated_report':str(report),'sha256':sha256_file(report),'imported_executed_statement_counts':{name:len(lines) for name,lines in mapping.items()}},sort_keys=True),flush=True)
